Bytebox help menu:

<> - Required argument
[] - Optional elements

help - show this menu

read - print the entire database

get/
    get <row> <column>    - print an element from the database
    getrow <row>          - print a row from the database
    getline <line>        - print a line from the database

add/
    add [elements]        - add a new line to the database
    addrow <row_name>     - add a new row to the database

delete/
    delete <row> <column> - delete an element from the database
    delrow <row>          - delete a row from the database
    delline <line>        - delete a line from the database
